full_judgment:
The learned Advocate for the appellant has referred to the provisions of Article 113 of the Limitation Act and argues that the suit was barred by limitation as it was not riled within three years i.e. from the expiry of three years from 23.3.71 which is the date of expiry of 90 days from the issuance of the Income Tax Clearance Certificate. 

 18. Mr. Muzammel Hossain, the learned Advocate for the plaintiff-respondent, argues that the cause of action arose when the defendant company by letter dated 13.5.74 refused to perform the contract. He further argues that in view of the provision of Article 4 of President's Order No. 12 of 1972 the period between 1.3.71 to 1.3.72 (both days inclusive) shall be excluded computing the period of limitation prescribed for any legal proceeding. If this period is excluded, the suit is well within time even from the date of contract i.e. 17.8.70, as the suit was instituted on 7.6.74. We, therefore, find no substance in the argument of the learned Advocate for the defendant-appellant regarding limitation also. No other argument has been made by the learned. Advocate for the appellant-defendant.
